title: Scripture and Sanctification
definition: Scripture and sanctification belong together because God uses His Word to conform believers to the character of Christ.
summary: God sanctifies His people through the truth of His Word.
christFocus: Jesus sanctifies His Church by the Word and forms His people into His likeness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sanctification is not separated from truth. God uses Scripture to expose sin, renew the mind, strengthen faith, and train believers in righteousness.

The Word reveals Christ and shows believers what it means to live in union with Him. As the Spirit applies the Word, God's people grow in holiness and love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people want change without truth or growth without correction. Scripture and sanctification matters because God transforms His people through the Word He has given.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture examine your habits, motives, speech, and relationships. Receive correction as grace and practice obedience in dependence on the Spirit.
